suggestions.title: Semester ticket may soon overlap with your Deutschlandticket
suggestions.body: Hochschule Musterstadt says the Deutschlandsemesterticket will be included in your fees from Summer Semester 2027. Worth comparing that against your separate Deutschlandticket Abonnement so you don't end up paying for transport twice.
suggestions.rationale: The re-registration letter (doc_nba3k0ka85q0) mentions the semester ticket, while you still hold a separate Deutschlandticket contract (ctr_cmeadtk38mac, 756 euros/year).

suggestions.title: Girokonto fee is rising - a good moment to compare accounts
suggestions.body: Musterbank is raising the Girokonto Klassik fee from 4.90 to 6.90 euros per month. Since they need your explicit consent, this is a natural point to check whether a free or cheaper student account elsewhere would suit you better.
suggestions.rationale: Based on Musterbank's price-increase letter (doc_0b2t88kqsf2n) for the Girokonto Klassik contract (ctr_611d1sk7v1cr).

suggestions.title: Check if teeth cleaning (PZR) is covered before your appointment
suggestions.body: Professional teeth cleaning (PZR) is often not fully covered by statutory health insurance and may come with an out-of-pocket cost. It could be worth confirming coverage with Muster BKK before your 8 Oct appointment.
suggestions.rationale: The dental appointment reminder (doc_xa0f5gvpe0w2) includes a PZR check-up alongside the regular check-up.

suggestions.title: Reconcile the TechMarkt invoice and reminder to avoid double paying
suggestions.body: You have both the original TechMarkt invoice (89.99 euros) and a later reminder for 94.99 euros including a late fee. It's worth checking your own records to confirm which one you'll settle, so nothing gets paid twice or missed.
suggestions.rationale: TechMarkt Online's invoice (doc_jcbakmxv29p8) and its 1st reminder (doc_1ndcj96tf28z) both reference the same claim and explicitly warn not to pay both.

suggestions.title: Use your new enrolment certificate for recurring submissions
suggestions.body: You just received your Winter 2026/27 certificate of enrolment. Your gym membership, employer and the scholarship foundation all ask for a fresh certificate each semester, so this is a good moment to send it around.
suggestions.rationale: New certificate (doc_50t54msvdfcy) matches recurring requirements at FitWell (itm_9pe1yez2k9k9), Muster Tech GmbH (itm_vrtb25ccjmkt) and the scholarship foundation (itm_gmymk62nzs8x).
